selected_subset: Six published-study snRNA-seq donors present in the HCA project and author annotation CSV; additional current GEO samples excluded before target analysis
source_files: input-manifest.json; 21 size/hash-pinned raw and annotation files
access: Dryad dataset version314311 metadata read; download endpoints HTTP403. Official HCA public S3 mirror used instead, exact SHA256 checked for every file. One HTTP502 API index retry succeeded.
independence: Separate human donor cohort from the earlier bulk NAFLD analysis; no matched identities enabling an exhaustive overlap audit. Original study discussed this pathway, so not blind mechanistic validation. No therapy, longitudinal recovery or alcohol-specific conclusion.
redistribution: Publish own code and derived donor/cell-type aggregates. Raw matrices, individual-cell annotations, full metadata contacts and publications stay outside the repository; original source terms remain unchanged.
